name: M11-NOV-00b preregistration amendment 1
reason: Before any PubMed tool call, inspection of the configured validation path showed that _build_search_canonical_params supplies query, max_papers, slug, and run_id, while the maintained tool defaults omitted recency_years to zero. The original preregistration described that default as an explicit wire parameter.

correction.recency_years: Omitted in both arms to match _build_search_canonical_params; the maintained PubMed MCP tool default is 0 (no recency restriction).
correction.comparison_status_at_amendment: No PubMed MCP tool call or outcome observed.
